scientific_integrity: All theorem clauses derived from a complete gap/side-label proof, with independent finite exact coefficient enumeration m=5..24. No claim of independent review or full literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Möbius ladders M_{2m} with m>=5; distance-three packings and direct/strong three-capacities only. Small ladders, patient tours and other distance thresholds not classified. Earlier McSorley (1998) enumeration manuscript inaccessible; historical priority qualified.
title: Distance-three packing polynomials and exact three-capacities of Möbius ladders
